originals.name: Named and raid scale tiers
originals.idea: Three tiers (normal, named, raid) decided by a name rule and a raid flag.
originals.change: Tier names and numbers. Rows 7 and 23.

originals.name: Weighted spawn group with per-type cap and retry
originals.idea: Weighted roll, a cap check per type, and a five-second retry when capped.
originals.change: Caps become zone data fields. Row 23.

originals.name: Respawn with variance and persisted death time
originals.idea: Respawn at plus or minus half a variance window, written to the database at death.
originals.keep: Variance window (zone/spawn2.cpp:124) and the death write (zone/spawn2.cpp:469).
originals.change: Storage moves to our ledger. Rows 23 and 17.

originals.name: Ratio hate with two-strike out-of-range removal
originals.idea: Hate as a ratio to the top entry, and removal after two out-of-range ticks.
originals.keep: Clamp 1 to 999 (zone/hate_list.cpp:343); removal on second tick (zone/hate_list.cpp:871-873).
originals.change: Our hate list lives in the engine. Row 4, MAX_ATTACKERS = 3.

originals.name: Smart target preference as data
originals.idea: Target preference rules as named numbers.
originals.keep: Sitting +35 percent, critically wounded +100 percent, melee range +10 percent, tunnel vision 0.75 (common/ruletypes.h:712-719).

originals.name: Global loot filter
originals.idea: A loot table filtered by level, raid, rare, race, class, body type and hot zone.
originals.keep: AND across rule kinds, OR within one kind (zone/global_loot_manager.cpp:116-185).

originals.name: Death tax with a level gate and corpse window
originals.idea: Experience loss from a level gate, a corpse window, and a respawn countdown.
originals.keep: Gate at level 10, multiplier 3 (3.5 percent), resurrection window 3 hours (common/ruletypes.h:45-56), respawn-from-hover 300 s (common/ruletypes.h:126-127).

originals.name: Light ladder as glow tiers
originals.idea: Eleven named glow tiers with a highest-wins slot.
originals.change: Names and colours; check the glow at 375 px. Rows 14 and 16.
